messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging Sam (on-call). Observed P99 tail latency spike on streaming endpoints for model redwood/open-llm-int8-v2 since 1795123000. Impact: streaming stalls, partial responses, some client connections timed out. Alerting thresholds breached (p95>300ms, p99>1.2s) and SLO sliding window showing sustained regression.

sam: I'm on it. pulling graphs now — sam is looking at live dashboards.

irene: saw the spike correlate with the quantization profile push at ~1795122800. That roll applied a new int8 calibration across prod.

nate: confirmed. kernel selection changed to int8-agg-optimized for many routes. We also started continuous batching update at same time. Could be interaction.

sam: Maria, any customers reporting errors?

maria: CS triage — a handful of enterprise chatflows got truncated responses, 2 customers reported streaming stalls and replays. One opened a ticket referencing partial outputs. Not major data loss but UX-critical.

cleo: quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce on canary / 2) rollback quant profile / 3) route traffic to fp16 fallback or dedicated pool / 4) enable stream watchdog and KV-cache bypass for affected routes.

irene: reproducing on canary now — running sequence-length heavy prompt (12k tokens). Int8 path shows p99 spikes and intermittent stalls during KV cache warmup. kp: likely calibration produced poor dynamic range for some keys, causing extra dequant overhead + cache misses.

nate: looking at runtime logs: lots of WARNs around dequant failure & fallback: 
```
2026-07-12T23:07:12Z WARN dequantize_slow_path: key_chunk_mismatch for layer 11
2026-07-12T23:07:13Z INFO fallback_to_fp16_kernel
2026-07-12T23:07:13Z DEBUG kv_cache_miss: client=api-prod-34 route=/v1/chat/stream
```

sam: okay prioritize mitigation. Rollback quant profile to previous stable (int8-v1) for prod? Or enable automatic fallback to fp16 for streaming route and drain nodes on new profile? Pros/cons?

irene: rollback safest fastest. We can flip profile config in config-store (feature flag) and restart worker groups gradually. Steps: 
1) set /models/open-llm/quant_profile -> int8-v1
2) trigger graceful worker reload for streaming pool
3) watch p95/p99 and KV hit rates

cleo: If rollback takes too long, temporary in-flight mitigation: route streaming traffic to dedicated fp16 pool by policy: route_policy: prefer(fp16_pools) for customer-tier enterprise. That avoids full rollback and minimizes customer impact.

maria: please do that for the two affected customers now if routing policy can be applied quickly — they are asking for immediate fix.

nate: I can switch routing policy for those customer routes to fp16 within 90s. Doing it now: 
```
# switch route policy
redwoodctl route update --route-id cust-42-chat --policy prefer:fp16_pools
redwoodctl route update --route-id cust-77-chat --policy prefer:fp16_pools
```

sam: executing rollback path in parallel. Irene, can you flip the quant_profile flag? I'll coordinate worker reloads with Nate.

irene: flipping flag now. set_key success. Propagating to config-cache.

irene: cmd: 
```
kvstore set /models/open-llm/quant_profile int8-v1 --env prod
```

cleo: Nate, prepare nodes for graceful restart. We'll do canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Watch streaming stall metric and tail latency.

nate: canary started. 5% pool restarted, p99 dropped from 1.25s to 430ms in 3 mins for canary nodes. KV hit ratio improved on canary.

sam: good sign. Proceed to 25%.

nate: 25% done, p99 across those nodes ~380ms. Rolling remainder.

irene: config-cache TTL was 30s so propagation should be rapid; seeing fewer fallback-to-fp16 logs after restart.

maria: CS update: customers on routed fp16 pools report recovered streams, ticket notes: latency improved. Sending a note: "We've applied a mitigation and are rolling a stable config".

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident severity set to Sev3 (streaming degradation affecting small set of customers). Paging window extended.

cleo: After full roll, we need a root cause doc: hypothesize that int8 calibration produced large quantization error for keys at layer 11 exacerbated by continuous batching pattern creating cache miss storms. Also investigate kernel scheduling interaction.

irene: saving copies of calibration artifacts and calibration logs: /var/artifacts/quant_calib/1795122800-int8-v2/*. Tarred.

nate: will open a runtime ticket: RUNTIME-1429 "int8-v2 dequant fallback storms under high-seq streaming" and attach logs.

sam: Postmortem owners: Irene (ML infra lead), Nate (runtime), Cleo (oncall SRE), Maria (customer comms). Target P0: rollback complete and customers stabilized. Next steps:
- deep-dive calibration data & quant metrics (irene)
- kernel scheduling and batching interaction replay (nate)
- traffic-policy rollback safety docs and quick-runbook (cleo)
- customer follow-up notes + status update (maria)

irene: agreed. I'll also add a test harness that replays high-seq chat sessions through int8-v2 on canary with KV warmup to catch this earlier.

maria: I'll draft the customer status email and include mitigation details + ETA for RCA.

sam: Great work team. Closing oncall handoff in 30m — leave the thread with status updates only. If p99 resurges, page again.

cleo: final note: add an automated gating check on calibration artifacts that flags layers with excessive dynamic range changes > 12 bits from previous profile. Should have prevented this.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, mitigations=[rollback_quant_profile,intel_route_to_fp16], severity=Sev3, owners=[irene,nate,cleo,maria].

sam: logging final metrics and will kick off postmortem doc template in #postmortems. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
